name: print-social-black-white-green-instagram-frame-set-with-chevrons-and-geometric-blocks
title: Green Geometry and Blue Chevron Post Frames
whatItIs: Four Instagram post frames on light grey with the title 'TITLE OF YOUR UPCOMING POST.': a white post over a green and black geometric block pattern, a black post with blue bands and a row of fading arrows, a black post over blue chevrons and a black post above the green pattern, each with a top logo row and like, comment and share icons.
whatItMeans: Swapping the same title in different backgrounds shows a modular system, and fading arrows suggest movement to the next slide.
techniques: Same headline over four different backgrounds
Green quarter-circle and stripe block pattern
Blue chevrons and bands as an alternate motif
Row of arrows fading in opacity
Real platform frames around each post

vocabulary.definition: A template shown inside platform post chrome.
A row of arrows reducing in opacity to imply motion.
Blocks each holding a quarter of a circle.
